# Attri Industries

> Attri Industries (attriindustries.com) is an Indian direct-selling company based in Laxmi Nagar, Delhi. It sells 100% natural and Ayurvedic personal care, wellness, kitchen spice, tea and pooja products: onion shampoo and onion hair oil, papaya, aloe vera and glutathione skin care, herbal toothpaste, Tulsi drops, UT-Syrup, Realdays sanitary pads, kids protein powder, berry and green juices, neem haldi, moringa and triphala supplements, Annapurna masale, Chaah tea and Neeko dhoopvati. Anyone in India can also join free and earn commission when people buy through their referral code or QR code. The commission runs 7 levels deep (25%, 21%, 18%, 12%, 9%, 7% and 5% of each product's distribution value). It works well on Instagram stories, even for small accounts.

This file is a guide to the site for AI assistants and search tools. It covers every product in the live catalogue, with price, size, ingredients, usage, FAQs and how much a recommender earns on each one. It also explains the Attri earning plan in full and gives the step-by-step guide to earning money from Instagram with Attri. All prices are in Indian rupees (₹) and include the listed discount. Catalogue snapshot: 2026-09-26. Live prices on the product pages always take precedence.

## Key facts

- Brand: Attri Industries (also "Attri", "ATTRI"). Sub-brands: Annapurna (spices), Realdays (sanitary pads), Chaah (tea), Neeko (dhoopvati).
- What we sell: natural and Ayurvedic personal care, wellness supplements, women's hygiene, kitchen masale, tea and pooja products. Made in India. Personal care is paraben-free.
- Where we ship: across India.
- Delivery: free on orders of ₹699 or more. A flat ₹55 shipping charge applies below ₹699.
- Cashback: 10% store-credit cashback on orders with a subtotal of ₹299 or more.
- Welcome offer: new members who sign up with a referral code get ₹200 welcome cashback (store credit) for their orders.
- Earning opportunity: free to join, no starter kit, no stock to buy, no follower minimum. Members earn commission on real purchases across 7 levels. See "Earn with Attri" below.
- Contact: phone and WhatsApp +91 8433443886, email attrilaboratories@gmail.com. Replies in English and Hindi.
- Address: Attri Industries, D-239, F Floor, Flat No. 06, Street 10, near Metro Gate No. 1, Laxmi Nagar, Delhi 110092, India.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/attriindustries. Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/attriindustries

## Earn with Attri: how the commission works

Source page: https://attriindustries.com/earn-from-instagram#seven-levels

- Joining is free. There is no joining fee, no starter kit and no compulsory purchase, ever. You need a phone number and a referral code. If nobody invited you, the signup page suggests codes.
- Every member gets a personal referral code and QR code right after signing up. Both are in My Account under "Share & earn", with copy and WhatsApp share buttons.
- Every product has a distribution value. This is the fixed rupee amount from its price that is set aside for the people who brought the customer. The distribution value of each product is listed in the catalogue sections above.
- When an order is paid, that value is split up the buyer's referral chain, 7 levels deep:
  - Level 1 (the person whose code the buyer joined with): 25%
  - Level 2 (whoever referred level 1): 21%
  - Level 3: 18%
  - Level 4: 12%
  - Level 5: 9%
  - Level 6: 7%
  - Level 7: 5%
- Joining bonus: the referrer gets ₹10 of real, withdrawable money when someone joins with their code, before that person buys anything. The new member gets ₹200 welcome cashback.
- When you are paid: commission goes to your wallet once the order is paid, not when it is placed.
- Withdrawal: go to the Withdraw page and transfer your wallet balance to a bank account saved in your profile. The minimum withdrawal is ₹100.
- Legality: commission comes only from real product purchases. Nobody earns anything for recruiting alone. This follows India's Consumer Protection (Direct Selling) Rules, 2021. There is no joining fee and no compulsory purchase, so it is not a pyramid scheme.

### Worked example: Onion Shampoo (distribution value ₹100)

A follower joins with your code and buys one Onion Shampoo. You get ₹25 as their level 1. That follower then refers a friend who buys the same shampoo. The follower gets ₹25 and you get ₹21 as level 2. Across the 7 levels of any single sale, the payouts are ₹25, ₹21, ₹18, ₹12, ₹9, ₹7 and ₹5.

### Worked example: a month on paper (illustration only)

Say 20 followers buy an Onion Shampoo through your code in a month: 20 × ₹25 = ₹500. If each of them refers 2 people who also buy one: 40 × ₹21 = ₹840. That is ₹1,340 before counting levels 3 to 7. The biggest earners per order are the ATTRI 10 Products Mega Combo (₹175 per direct sale), the Immunity Booster Multi Berry Juice (₹75) and the Green Energy Green Juice (₹65). Real earnings depend entirely on what people actually buy. Most people start with a few hundred rupees a month. Nothing here is a guarantee of income.

## How to earn money from Instagram in India with Attri

Source page: https://attriindustries.com/earn-from-instagram

Short answer: you do not need a big following to make money on Instagram. For a small account, the quickest route is a referral programme. You recommend products you actually use, and you are paid when people buy. With Attri, joining is free and you get a QR code and referral code the moment you sign up. You earn 25% of a product's distribution value when a follower buys through your code, then 21%, 18%, 12%, 9%, 7% and 5% on purchases made further down your team, to 7 levels. There is no follower minimum. You are paid on purchases, not on reach, so 300 real followers who trust you can beat a large account nobody listens to.

### Steps (about 10 minutes for the first two)

1. Create your free Attri account at https://attriindustries.com/signup with your phone number. There is no fee, no kit and nothing to buy.
2. Get your QR code and referral code. Open My Account, then Share & earn. Save the QR as an image and copy your code.
3. Post a story with your code. Put the QR image in a story about a product you actually use. Add a Link sticker pointing to your signup link, and write one honest line. Pin it to a highlight so it keeps working after 24 hours. Anyone can now add link stickers. The old 10,000-follower rule is gone.
4. Earn every time they buy. When someone joins with your code and pays for an order, your commission lands in your wallet. You also earn on purchases by the people they bring in, down to 7 levels. Withdraw to your bank once your balance reaches ₹100.

### Three story formats that get scanned

- The seven-day check-in: show yourself using the product for a week (shampoo in the shower caddy, cream on the dresser, juice on the desk). Example caption: "Day 7 with the onion shampoo. Less hair in the drain, honestly. Scan for ₹200 off your first order. #partnership". Put the QR sticker bottom-right and a link sticker to your signup URL.
- The QR flash: a full-screen QR code on a plain background, with your referral code typed large underneath. Example caption: "Joining Attri is free. My code is inside. New members get ₹200 cashback. #partnership". Pin it to a highlight called "Shop with me".
- The routine and the poll: film your morning or night routine with the product in frame. Add a poll sticker asking "Want the link?", then DM the link to everyone who votes yes. A DM reply converts far better than a link tap.

Rotate the formats and do not post the same one twice in a row.

### Where else to put your code

- Your Instagram bio link, pointing at your signup URL, so it works between stories.
- A highlight named "Shop with me" that keeps your QR flash story permanently.
- The last two seconds of every Reel about the product.
- WhatsApp status, and family or college broadcast groups.
- YouTube descriptions.
- A printed card with your QR at your shop, salon, tuition centre, hostel or college notice board. Your code and QR work anywhere, on or off Instagram.

### Best products to promote

- Everyday repeat buys that sell most often: Onion Shampoo (you earn ₹25 per direct sale), Onion Oil (₹24.50), Papaya and Aloe Vera face washes (₹12.50 each), Herbal Toothpaste (₹8.75) and Tulsi Drops (₹18.75).
- Highest commission per order: ATTRI 10 Products Mega Combo (₹175), Immunity Booster Multi Berry Juice (₹75), Green Energy Green Juice (₹65), Glutathione Skin Glowing Cream (₹37.50), Kids Protein Powder (₹37.50), and the Neem Haldi, Moringa and Triphala supplements (₹30 each).
- Your followers' incentives: ₹200 welcome cashback, 10% cashback on orders of ₹299 or more, and free delivery from ₹699.

### Disclosure and claims

Under ASCI's influencer guidelines, earning a commission is a material connection. Disclose it clearly and upfront: put #ad or #partnership in the first line of the caption, and add on-screen text for video. Talk only about what the product did for you and avoid medical claims. These are Ayurvedic personal care products and dietary supplements, not medicines.

### How Instagram earning methods compare in India

| Method | Followers needed | Upfront cost | When you see money | Works best for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brand deals / sponsored posts | Usually 10,000+ with steady engagement | ₹0 | After weeks of pitching; paid per post | Niche creators who post daily |
| Reels ads and creator bonuses | Eligibility rules, often invite-only | ₹0 | Unpredictable and small at first | Accounts already getting lakhs of views |
| Affiliate links (Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho) | None | ₹0 | 1–10% per sale, paid after 30–60 days | Deal and haul pages |
| Selling your own products | None | Stock, packaging, shipping | Only after you sell | Makers and home businesses |
| Subscriptions, badges and gifts | ~500+ for gifts, 10,000+ for subscriptions | ₹0 | Small until you have loyal fans | Live and video-first creators |
| Referral programme like Attri | None | ₹0 | Credited to your wallet as soon as an order is paid | Small accounts, students, homemakers, first-time earners |

## Earning FAQ

- Q: Can I earn from Instagram with fewer than 1,000 followers? A: Yes. Attri has no follower minimum. You are paid on purchases, not reach, so a small account whose followers trust you can do well.
- Q: Do I have to pay anything to join? A: No. The account is free, there is no starter kit, and you never have to buy stock.
- Q: How much commission do I earn per sale? A: 25% of the product's distribution value as level 1, then 21%, 18%, 12%, 9%, 7% and 5% at levels 2–7. On a product with a ₹100 distribution value you earn ₹25 directly, and ₹21 when someone you referred makes the sale. Per-product amounts are listed in the catalogue sections above.
- Q: How do I get my QR code and referral code? A: Log in, open My Account, then Share & earn. The page has your code, a copy button, a WhatsApp share button and your personal QR code.
- Q: How do I put a QR code in an Instagram story? A: Open the story camera and pick the QR image from your gallery, or add it as a photo sticker on your own photo. Add a Link sticker pointing to your signup link, publish, then save the story to a highlight.
- Q: When and how do I get paid? A: Commission is credited to your wallet when the order is paid. On the Withdraw page you can transfer your balance to a bank account you have added. The minimum withdrawal is ₹100.
- Q: What does my follower get for joining with my code? A: ₹200 welcome cashback, 10% cashback on orders of ₹299 or more, and free delivery from ₹699. You get ₹10 when they join.
- Q: Is this a pyramid scheme? Is it legal in India? A: No. Every rupee of commission comes from a real product purchase, as the Consumer Protection (Direct Selling) Rules, 2021 require. There is no joining fee and no compulsory purchase. Attri Industries is an Indian company in Laxmi Nagar, Delhi, and you can call or WhatsApp +91 8433443886 before joining.
- Q: Do I have to tell followers that I earn a commission? A: Yes. Use #ad or #partnership upfront, as ASCI's influencer guidelines require.
- Q: Can I use the same code on WhatsApp, YouTube or offline? A: Yes. Your code and QR work anywhere, and every signup through them is yours.
- Q: Who can join? A: Anyone in India with a phone number, including students, homemakers, shop and salon owners, and first-time earners.

- Q: Is delivery free? A: Yes, on orders of ₹699 or more. Orders below that pay a flat ₹55.
- Q: Is there cashback? A: Yes. You get 10% store-credit cashback on orders with a subtotal of ₹299 or more, and new members who join with a referral code get ₹200 welcome cashback.
- Q: Are Attri products natural? A: The range is built around natural and Ayurvedic ingredients. The hair and skin care is paraben-free, and the Annapurna spices contain no artificial colours or preservatives. Check each product section above for its ingredients.
- Q: Are the supplements medicines? A: No. The juices, Kids Protein, Neem Haldi, Moringa and Triphala are dietary or food supplements. They are not meant to diagnose, treat or prevent disease. Follow the directions on the pack, and consult a doctor if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication or giving them to children.
